from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,json,time
r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1');s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark');a=s/'unsafe-default-candidate'
def phase(name,**kw):
 (s/'mode3-literal-acceptance-state.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(phase=name,utc=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),**kw),indent=2)+'\n');print(name,kw,flush=True)
e=dict(os.environ,EKA2L1_WASM_BUILD_DIR=str(a),EKA2L1_AOT_IR_MODE='7',EKA2L1_AOT_EAGER_REGIONS='0',EKA2L1_TLB_HASH='1',EKA2L1_SHARED_AUDIO='1',EKA2L1_BENCHMARK_AOT='5',EKA2L1_AOT_VERIFY='0',EKA2L1_CODE_COMPARE='2',EKA2L1_CODE_LOOKUP='0',EKA2L1_EXECUTION_LIMITS='512,16,8,512',EKA2L1_PREDICATED_LEAVES='1',EKA2L1_LEAF_FEATURES='128',EKA2L1_UNSAFE_CODE='3',EKA2L1_EXIT_CENSUS='0')
for k in ['LD_LIBRARY_PATH','EKA2L1_GUEST_PROFILE','EKA2L1_AOT_DIAGNOSTICS']:e.pop(k,None)
def run(args,name,cwd=r,env=e):
 with(s/name).open('w')as log:subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=1800)
 print(name+' PASS',flush=True)
try:
 phase('faults')
 run(['python3','src/tests/benchmark/run_cpu_fault_matrix.py',str(a),str(s/'mode3-literal-fault'),'--ir-policy','7','--code-compare','2','--tlb-hash','1','--execution-limits','512,16,8,512','--predicated-leaves','1','--exit-census','0','--leaf-features','128','--unsafe-code','3','--literal-pc-veneers'],'mode3-literal-fault.log')
 q=json.loads((s/'mode3-literal-fault/summary.json').read_text());assert q['completed_cases']==46016 and all(x['all_fields_match']==x['cases']for x in q['results'])
 for scene in ['standard','long']:
  phase('native_replay',scene=scene)
  frames,start,route,ref,pcm=(1600,21000000,'snakes.input','merge-20260930-native',4656051)if scene=='standard'else(360,42000000,'snakes-length-long.input','merge-20260930-long-native',2832756)
  out=s/f'mode3-literal-replay-{scene}'
  run(['node','benchmark.ts',str(s/'assets'),str(out),str(frames),str(r/'src/tests/benchmark'/route),str(start)],f'mode3-literal-replay-{scene}.log',r/'src/tests/wasm')
  run(['python3','src/tests/benchmark/compare.py',str(s/ref/'run-0/frames'),str(out)],f'mode3-literal-compare-{scene}.json')
  c=json.loads((s/f'mode3-literal-compare-{scene}.json').read_text());assert c['match']and c['frames']==frames and c['audio']['sample_frames']==pcm
  q=json.loads((out/'report.json').read_text());assert q['unsafe_code']==3 and q['unsafe_code_initial']==3 and q['verify_aot']==0 and q['leaf_features']==128 and q['predicated_leaves']==1
 phase('acceptance_complete')
 (s/'mode3-literal-acceptance-complete.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(accepted=True,archive=str(a),mode=3,features=128)))
except Exception as error:phase('failure',error=str(error));raise

from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,json,sys
r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1');s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark');a=s/'unsafe-default-candidate';baseline=a
scene,batch=sys.argv[1:];assert scene in ('long','standard') and batch in ('a','b')
start,end,route=(42000000,60000000,'snakes-length-long.input')if scene=='long'else(60000000,78000000,'snakes.input')
order={'a':['control','candidate'],'b':['candidate','control']}[batch]
args=['python3','src/tests/benchmark/serial_variants.py',str(s/'assets'),str(s/f'mode3-literal-timing-{scene}-{batch}')]+[f'{n}={baseline if n=="baseline"else a}'for n in order]
for name in order:
 for option,value in [('unsafe-code','3'),('ir-mode','7'),('eager-regions','0'),('tlb-hash','1'),('code-compare','2'),('code-lookup','0'),('execution-limits','512,16,8,512'),('predicated-leaves','1'),('leaf-features',str(128 if name=='candidate'else 0)),('input',str(r/'src/tests/benchmark'/route))]:args.extend(['--'+option,f'{name}={value}'])
args+=['--start-us',str(start),'--end-us',str(end)]
subprocess.run(args,cwd=r,env=dict(os.environ,EKA2L1_SHARED_AUDIO='1'),check=True)
rows=json.loads((s/f'mode3-literal-timing-{scene}-{batch}/measurements.json').read_text());assert len(rows)==4
assert len({(x['measurement']['first_instructions'],x['measurement']['last_instructions'],x['measurement']['presentations'])for x in rows})==1
print(scene,batch,'identical guest work verified',flush=True)
